rules: Connect only explicit measured levels within one source/task/benchmark and snapshot. Never copy, infer, average, interpolate or rescale a missing score.
Order points by the documented setting, not by observed score. Non-monotonic measured quality scores are retained.
Source-labeled configurations establish named product/version settings, not immutable checkpoint identity. Unpublished evaluation settings remain null.
Source price quotes are distinct from certified evaluation-run cost. Pricing-only evidence has null sourcePoolId and null score.
Use generic CI where confidence level is unpublished. Never convert Design Arena win-rate margin or btStdErr into source-published Elo CI endpoints.
Unranked Design Arena public-response-only observations retain null rank and require explicit integration treatment. Historical Arena dates stay separate.

sourcePools.benchmark: Design Arena Elo (Bradley-Terry), public imagetoimage pool

series.name: P-Image-Ideogram
series.identityBasis: Same source-named model version/product and a provider-documented configurable parameter. Immutable checkpoint equality is not established.
notes: All five levels already exist in research/images.json and were reconfirmed in the live All models table.
Keep the measured non-monotonic High and Very High scores. Do not smooth, sort by score, or imply a guaranteed quality improvement.
AA prices match Pruna 1K rates, but AA methodology generates at highest supported resolution before downscaling. Actual scored-request cost is not established.

series.name: Ideogram 4.0
series.identityBasis: Same source-named model version/product and a provider-documented configurable parameter. Immutable checkpoint equality is not established.
notes: Provider documentation confirms rendering_speed=default|quality within the same Ideogram 4.0 endpoint.
Unlabeled AA row is interpreted as provider default under AA default-settings methodology; do not label it Low. Turbo has a price but no measured row in this pool.
Native Ideogram prices are flat per image. Do not replace them with fal per-megapixel quotes.

series.name: Ideogram 4.0 Fast
series.identityBasis: Same source-named model version/product and a provider-documented configurable parameter. Immutable checkpoint equality is not established.
notes: Fast is its own CFG-distilled, QAD-trained checkpoint. Within that endpoint, rendering_speed=BALANCED|QUALITY selects denoising presets.
Keep Fast separate from native Ideogram 4.0 and Instant. The unlabeled row uses a documented default inference, not a benchmark-published parameter record.
AA lists 1K representative prices. The highest-resolution evaluation policy prevents claiming exact benchmark spend from these quotes.

series.name: P-Image-Ideogram
series.identityBasis: Same source-named model version/product and a provider-documented configurable parameter. Immutable checkpoint equality is not established.
notes: Source labels match a single named product with five official modes. No pinned checkpoint, prompt upsampling, resolution, or benchmark configuration is published. Low and medium are in the public image response but omitted by the current UI.
Low and Medium require explicit unranked-data inclusion. Their ranks remain null; never assign them inferred published ranks.
Keep source non-monotonic scores. Price quotes match Pruna 1K rates but evaluation resolution is not supplied.

series.name: Ideogram 4.5
series.identityBasis: Same source-named model version/product and a provider-documented configurable parameter. Immutable checkpoint equality is not established.
notes: Strongest version-specific pair. Official 4.5 documentation establishes Very Low and High as modes of the same model. Keep this editing pool separate from text-to-image; the precise evaluation endpoint and resolution are not published.
Low and Medium remain unmeasured. Do not insert null-score points into a measured quality line.
Retain source btStdErr as a standard error, never as explicit 95% CI bounds.

familyAudit.classification: quality settings supported; multi-setting benchmark series unavailable
familyAudit.reason: AA has High for 2, Max for each 2.5. Arena has Medium for 2 and no quality labels on 2.5. These are different source/task/version pools. Sunburst and Flare are distinct model IDs.

familyAudit.classification: distinct models or aliases, not ordinal quality levels
familyAudit.reason: Do not connect the original, Quality, Pro, dated 2.0 or Canvas identifiers as low/medium/high. Quality and its Pro alias redirect only from 2026-11-02. Current 2.0 Auto is not a fixed historical quality.
Only explicit settings within one version/product form a series. Never connect 3.0, 4.0, 4.5 and P-Image as quality levels.
Fast model card establishes QAD-trained FP4-targeted weights; Instant is a separate eight-step checkpoint. Keep both separate from native 4.0. Fast itself exposes Balanced/Quality presets.

familyAudit.family: FLUX dev / pro / max / Turbo / Flash / klein 4B / 9B
familyAudit.classification: distinct model or derived endpoint variants, no approved quality line
familyAudit.reason: Shared family branding is insufficient to establish an unchanged exact checkpoint and configurable quality level. Model-size changes and derived Turbo/Flash endpoints cannot be interpreted as Low/Medium/High.

familyAudit.family: Krea 2 Medium / Large / Turbo and Krea 3 Fast / Ultra
familyAudit.reason: Medium in Krea 2 is part of the model name. No primary identity proof was collected to map these benchmark labels to one unchanged quality parameter; do not connect by suffix alone.

familyAudit.family: Gemini 3.1 Flash 1K/default versus 2K and Gemini 3 Pro Preview versus 2K
familyAudit.classification: resolution candidate, held for exact evaluation configuration

notes: No configuration or generation-price columns. Named suffixes only establish source-labeled variants; dated snapshots do not establish quality settings.
Full split historical snapshots are reported separately by date and category.

recommendation: Start with AA P-Image-Ideogram five levels and native Ideogram 4 Default/Quality. Keep AA Fast as a separate checkpoint with its own rendering presets. Add Design Arena P-Image five levels only with explicit public-response-only treatment for Low/Medium, and add its separate Ideogram 4.5 editing pair. Keep Grok Auto/Medium conditional and GPT low/medium prices in an unscored list. Do not advertise exact evaluation costs where configuration matching is unpublished.
